fields.summary_ko.0: Palo Alto Networks (PANW:NASDAQ) announced on November 18 upward guidance revision alongside acquisition of Applied Compute for $4.5 billion, with Chamath Palihapitiya suggesting potential to grow into a trillion-dollar company within 10 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Growth from current $290 billion market cap to $1 trillion requires 13% annual growth, though current 79x forward EPS multiple (5-year average 57x) requires 17% annual growth to be justified.
